purpose: Reuse the validated deidentified sheep-ovary SCT+BANKSY whole-tissue preprocessing and evidence-first R decision process for same-batch samples without copying sample-specific resolution choices, cluster labels or outcomes.

requires.fixed_preprocessing_only_if: StereoPy cellbin_PPed raw-count carrier contract is independently verified

membership_objects.initial_cluster_cohort: one immutable cohort per whole-tissue initial cluster; restart from project-local non-SCT raw counts and scan the full catalog
membership_objects.local_mixed_subcluster: exact second-round subcluster only after two or more separable competing identity cores trigger local splitting
membership_objects.post_merge_unresolved: biological unresolved membership after broad merge; eligible for broad-only Atlas rescue and final typed closure

open_world_lineage_discovery.rule: Review every catalog boundary in every sample and scan every unexplained multi-gene program for additional lineages. A not-supported decision is valid; absence in the reference case is not negative evidence and the catalog is not exhaustive.
open_world_lineage_discovery.candidate_trigger: coherent multi-gene program plus anti-marker compatibility and resolution/spatial support
open_world_lineage_discovery.candidate_action: record first-pass watch evidence only; allow second-round whole-subcluster or local outcomes to reconstruct known or missing broad lineages, and keep stable catalog-external programs unmodeled until review.

persistent_pool_route: disabled globally for every new project; legacy pool registries remain migration-only provenance
generic_rare_cell_route: disabled; Oocyte uses a temporary contamination-safe targeted cohort because zona/adjacent signal is a known confounder, not because it is rare.
quality_endpoint: moderate-or-higher broad classes plus high-confidence fine labels only
deviation_policy: Record a preset exception with the affected phase, current-sample evidence, reason and replacement safeguard; never silently skip or reorder a mandatory phase.
